subject: SCCs + HIPAA scope for BetterHealth onboarding
messages:
From: Katie Lewis <katie.lewis@betterhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:15:00Z
Subject: SCCs for BetterHealth onboarding — HIPAA/UK/EU transfer questions

Hi Neha / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro call today. We ran into a couple of legal/compliance clarifications before we can proceed with the pilot:

- Our workload handles PHI in scope of HIPAA; can Redwood commit to acting as a Processor (we are the Controller) and sign a BAA? If a full BAA isn't standard, what mitigations do you offer (Private deployment, data residency)?
- For transfers from the EU/UK to Redwood's US processing environment, we're trying to pick the right SCCs module. Our legal team suggested Module 2 (Controller -> Processor) with the UK Addendum, but they asked whether Module 3 would be needed in any of Redwood's subprocessing cases.
- Please share redacted SOC 2 Type II and any DPIA notes you have so we can loop our DPO.

Deliverables requested by 11/06 if possible: redacted SOC2, a short SCCs option matrix that explains Module 2 vs 3 tradeoffs, and an outline of logging/retention for audit requests.

Thanks — happy to set a short sync if helpful.

Attachments: BetterHealth_SCCs_questions.pdf (2 pages)

--
Katie Lewis
Head of Security & Compliance
BetterHealth Inc.
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Katie Lewis <katie.lewis@betterhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T12:30:00Z
Subject: Re: SCCs for BetterHealth onboarding — HIPAA/UK/EU transfer questions

Hi Katie — thanks for the clear list.

Short answers / plan:

- SCCs: Based on the Controller (BetterHealth) -> Processor (Redwood) relationship you described, Module 2 (Controller -> Processor) plus the UK Addendum is the default recommendation. Module 3 (Processor -> Processor) is only relevant if Redwood needs to transfer EU data onward to another processor outside the EU/UK — we'll be explicit in the DPA/subprocessor list when that applies.

- HIPAA: Redwood supports HIPAA customers via our Private deployment option and contractual controls. Our legal team is reviewing the BAA request; I don't want to promise signing a BAA until counsel confirms, but operationally we can offer:
  * Private VPC deployment and optional on-prem package
  * Contractual commitments on access controls and encryption
  * Audit/logging retention options tailored to PHI needs

- Evidence: we'll provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II, a concise SCCs-option matrix (pros/cons + UK Addendum notes), and a short DPIA/impact summary addressing PHI-specific controls.

Next steps: Marissa will pull the SOC2 and CAIQ notes; Markus/legal will prepare a DPA template with Module 2 language + UK Addendum and confirm BAA posture. I'll schedule a 30-min call for next week to walk your DPO through the options.

Deliver by 2026-11-05 EOD if possible.

Attachments: (none)

Best,

Neha Kapoor
Head of Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Katie Lewis <katie.lewis@betterhealth.com>

Date: 2026-11-04T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: SCCs for BetterHealth onboarding — HIPAA/UK/EU transfer questions

Neha,

Quick clarification from our DPO:

- Our dataset will include patient identifiers and treatment metadata (definitely PHI). We need confirmation that Redwood will only process PHI in its capacity as Processor and not act as a Controller for any analytics outputs that we provide.
- Logging/retention: standard retention is 12 months for audit logs; can you provide the default retention and whether that's configurable per customer?
- For SCCs: if Redwood engages a US-based subprocessor for telemetry or monitoring, does Redwood plan to rely on Module 3 for those transfers, or will subprocessor transfers be covered under Module 2 via subprocessors clause? (Our counsel wants explicit mapping.)

If useful I can share our DPO's short checklist — happy to jump on the proposed call.

Best,
Katie

Attachment: BetterHealth_DPO_checklist.docx
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Katie Lewis <katie.lewis@betterhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T16:02:00Z
Subject: Re: SCCs for BetterHealth onboarding — HIPAA/UK/EU transfer questions

Hi Katie — appreciate the details. Final plan below and attachments.

1) SCCs module choice: We will propose Module 2 (Controller -> Processor) with the UK Addendum as the default. For any onward transfers to subprocessors, Redwood will rely on the subprocessors clause in the DPA (we'll explicitly enumerate subprocessors and the transfer legal basis). If a transfer requires a Processor->Processor mapping in the SCCs language (Module 3), we will call it out in the DPA and provide the mapping table.

2) HIPAA / BAA: Our legal team is reviewing the BAA path. Operationally we can support PHI via Private deployment; if you prefer, we can restrict PHI processing to Private capacity to reduce surface area. I'll confirm BAA posture by 11/09.

3) Evidence bundle attached:
  - redacted_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (redacted SOC 2 Type II)
  - SCCs-option-matrix.xlsx (concise matrix: Module 2 vs Module 3, UK Addendum notes)
  - HIPAA-impact-notes.txt (short operational notes: retention, encryption, role-based access)

4) Logging/retention: default audit log retention is 12 months; configurable up to 36 months for enterprise contracts. We'll include adjustable retention clauses in the DPA.

5) Next step: propose a 30-min call with our legal & infra teams Tuesday 11/09 15:00 UTC — propose a calendar invite if that works.

Attachments: redacted_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf, SCCs-option-matrix.xlsx, HIPAA-impact-notes.txt

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
